_note: Service patterns per season, used to check that the chosen legs line up. Researched 27 Oct 2026; projected patterns are marked in the notes. Weekdays: sun mon tue wed thu fri sat.

sept27.label: September 2027
sept27.cpNote: Coastal Pacific start date unconfirmed: Great Journeys says 1 September; in 2024 it started on 19 September (then Thu–Sun). Confirm before booking.

sandflies.note: Sandflies: September is outside the October–April peak, but they are present all year.

general: Early spring: cool, with snow still on the tops; the Milford Road can have avalanche closures.

rnw.note: The Wanderer is listed for October and April, not September. Ask RealNZ about September sailings.

rnn.note: The Navigator is listed for May and August. Ask RealNZ about September sailings.

fj1.note: The Milford overnight starts in late October.

he6.note: Fixed sailings on 19 and 25 September 2027 (helicopter in: no other access).

winter27.label: Winter 2027
winter27.cpNote: The Coastal Pacific does not run 1 May–31 August. Picton to Christchurch would be by road instead.
general: Cold and short days; Milford Road avalanche closures possible.

rnw.note: The Wanderer runs in April and October, not winter.

rnn.note: Navigator listed for May and August (ensuite twins). Confirm which days it sails; if not on this day, add a night in Te Anau.

fj1.note: The Milford overnight runs late October to April only.

he4.note: Fixed sailings 1, 5 and 9 August 2027. Expect a waiting day.

he6.note: Fixed sailings in July and August 2027. Expect a waiting day.

sandflies.note: Sandflies: winter is the lowest period (a slight reduction in July and August), but they are never fully absent.

spring27.label: Spring 2027
spring27.cpNote: The Coastal Pacific has run Thu–Sun in spring (projected for 2027). Its 2027 start date is unconfirmed: 1 September or mid-September.
general: Labour Weekend (23–25 Oct) is busy on the roads.

rnw.note: Chosen: Wanderer sailing Tuesday 5 October 2027. In October 2027 it sails Tue, Thu and Sat (RealNZ booking calendar, checked 28 Oct 2026; 19 Oct not available).

rnn.note: The Navigator runs in May and August, not spring.

fj1.note: The Milford overnight sails nightly from late October; earlier in spring it isn't running.

he6.note: Fixed sailings on 19 Sep and 25 Sep 2027 only. Work the rail legs back from the sailing date; expect a waiting day.

sandflies.note: Sandflies: October is inside the October–April peak, so this misses the agreed sandfly constraint. Accepted by Andrew on 28 Oct 2026 to choose the October Wanderer; check with Millie. Take repellent and cover up.

autumn28.label: Autumn 2028
autumn28.cpNote: The Coastal Pacific has run daily from January to April in recent seasons (projected for 2028).

rnw.note: Wanderer listed for April (projected from 2027). Confirm which days it sails; if not on this day, add a night in Te Anau.

rnn.note: The Navigator runs in May and August, not autumn.

fj1.note: The Milford overnight runs until about 26 April.

he4.note: 2028 dates not yet published; in 2027 these sailed late January to early April on fixed dates. Expect a waiting day.

he6.note: 2028 dates not yet published; fixed sailing dates. Expect a waiting day.

sandflies.note: Sandflies: March–April is inside the October–April peak. Fails the agreed sandfly constraint.
